description: This Java class DeferredConnectionCheckHandler manages deferred connection checks for a Hono client, handling concurrent connection attempts and timeouts. It coordinates promise-like mechanisms to signal completion of connection attempts and handles expiration timers to fail pending checks if a timeout occurs.

classes.name: DeferredConnectionCheckHandler
classes.description: Handles deferred connection checks, managing ongoing connection attempts, tracking promises for connection verification, and handling timeouts.

classes.name: ExpiringConnectionCheckPromise
classes.description: Inner class representing a promise with an expiration timer to handle individual connection check completion or timeout.

methods.name: isConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Returns true if a connection attempt is currently ongoing (i.e., connectionCheckPromises is not null).

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Marks the start of a connection attempt by setting connectionCheckPromises to an empty list if currently null.

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptFinished
methods.description: Completes all accumulated connection check promises after a connection attempt has finished, using the provided AsyncResult to signal success or failure.

methods.name: addConnectionCheck
methods.description: Adds a new connection check promise which will be completed once the current connection attempt finishes or the timeout elapses. Returns true if added successfully.
